{{Quote|I don't know how you did it, recruit, but I have a feeling you've been marked for a one-in-a-million career!|The sergeant congratulates Davin Felth|<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''sergeant''' served as an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] training instructor at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. This [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] directed [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-AT pilot]] candidate [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] on an impromptu training exercise in command of a [[Walker/Legends|walker]], designated [[Landkiller One]], modified to simulate a surprise attack scenario. When Felth passed the test brilliantly, exposing a critical weakness in the AT-AT design, the sergeant expected the success of the scenario to propel Felth into an exceptional career. However, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], head of the Imperial AT-AT program, buried Felth in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] to mask the exposed weakness.
